name: Typeform Free
free_limit: Unlimited hosted Typeform questionnaires with 10 collected responses/month in total across the account; includes basic logic, embeds and result export.
watch_out: Only 10 responses/month across ALL forms; not ten per form. Typeform says it experiments with Free plan pricing/eligibility, so actual in-account allowances may vary. Larger quotas and premium features need payment; credit-card and commercial-use terms require confirmation.
